title: Carrying a Release Down to Whole Loads
content:
Grain moves in whole loads rather than to the bushel, so what may be released is carried down before the order is worked. This rule governs releases out of store under Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements.

## The provision

Where the grain is held at a rail terminal and what may be released stands above the rail lot count of 10 truck lots, what is released is carried down to a whole multiple of the truck lot of 1000 bushels.

Where the grain is not held at a rail terminal and a load-out has been worked on the agreement in the last twelve months, it is carried down to the next whole hundred bushels.

And otherwise it is released as it was worked out.

## The two figures the first line uses

A truck lot is 1000 bushels, and the rail lot count is 10 truck lots, which is 10000 bushels. The first line bites only where what may be released stands above that figure.

## Condition and result

| The house the grain is held at | What may be released | A load-out worked on the agreement in the last twelve months | What is released |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| a rail terminal | above 10000 bushels | either way | carried down to a whole multiple of 1000 bushels |
| a rail terminal | 10000 bushels or less | either way | as it was worked out |
| any other house | any quantity | yes | carried down to the next whole hundred bushels |
| any other house | any quantity | no | as it was worked out |

## Worked roundings, on hypothetical figures

**11840 bushels at a rail terminal.** The figure stands above 10000, so it is carried down to a whole multiple of 1000, which is 11000 bushels.

**9450 bushels at a rail terminal.** The figure does not stand above 10000, so 9450 bushels are released as worked out.

**11840 bushels at a country house with a load-out worked four months ago.** It is carried down to the next whole hundred, which is 11800 bushels.

**11840 bushels at a country house with no load-out on the agreement for two years.** The figure is released as it was worked out, at 11840 bushels.
